newsitem.title: USA: Progressive agrees to buy Midland Financial.
newsitem.headline: Progressive agrees to buy Midland Financial.

text.p: Progressive Corp said Wednesday it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Midland Financial Group Inc for $9 per share.
The Cleveland-based insurance holding company said it would buy all of Midland's outstanding stock, or about 5.5 million shares.
The deal is expected to be completed in the first quarter, Progressive said.
Midland said it will keep its identity and operate as a separate business unit.
On Wednesday the company announced an expected third quarter loss of about $4.5 to $6 million, or about $0.50 to $0.70 per share.
The company also said that its agreement in principle for a $20 million term loan from American Financial Group Inc has ended.
Midland shares rose to 8-3/8 early Wednesday afternoon, up from Tuesday's close of 6-7/8.
Progressive shares gained 1/8 from Tuesday's close to trade at about 69-1/4.
